description: Open a fresh browser on the page where the task's intended route begins and start recording its expected path. The page itself is step 1. Starting again discards the recording in progress.

account.description: Demo account saved by login (a1 …) if the route needs a signed-in user

task.description: Task id from path_tasks · plan-<n> for task n of a research not saved yet (new-research) · draft:<draft>:<index> for a saved draft

url.description: Full URL where the route starts — the local dev server is fine; only paths are saved

name: path_start
